data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The covering principle is: append-only identity is preserved on resumption whenever the protocol can deterministically quarantine the trailing partial fragment as a non-event, regardless of whether a barrier was explicitly emitted. The false dichotomy in SRC_001 (either explicit barrier or no safe recovery) is dissolved because a barrier is sufficient but not necessary\u2014framing-based quarantine is the necessary and sufficient condition.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If the storage medium treats any written byte as committed (e.g., some block devices), the inert-tail argument fails because there is no way to 'skip' the partial bytes without a rewrite or truncation operation that violates append-only at the storage layer.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the framing protocol is ambiguous about completeness under partial writes (e.g., length-prefix without end-marker), quarantine is non-deterministic and the covering principle does not apply.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the protocol requires the resumption point to be an explicitly marked event (not just any complete event), then barrier-less resumption is insufficient even with correct framing.","eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The distinction between 'last event written' and 'last byte written' is the key. Append-only identity is a property of events, not bytes. A barrier event makes quarantine trivial (the last event is explicitly marked as a suspend point). But framing-based quarantine achieves the same outcome: scan the log tail, identify the last byte sequence that satisfies complete-event framing criteria, treat everything after as inert bytes. The log is append-only in terms of events; the inert tail is not an event and appending after it (by overwriting or skipping) does not violate append-only semantics because no event existed there to corrupt.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
